rows.kind: refinement of his statement (stays as written unless it is our misreading)
rows.as_the_page_reads: celle d'un germe de voisinage cônique de X[_{I_0}], à celle d'une famille de germes de vois. côniques des X_i dans X
rows.should_read: holds for finitely many compact X_i (i in I_0), or for germs taken along positive functions lambda on X_i; fails for constant-lambda germs in general (X = R2, X_1 = {y=0}, X_2 = {y=e^{-x}}); the non-germ statement holds for a locally finite family
